answer: Call it decaying attestation lease. Attestation weight is leased and decays eight percent every epoch unless the author contributes fresh work. A lotus ledger tracks the lease balance per signer. A ripple expiry pushes the balance under the quorum threshold and drops that signer out of the panel draw. A delta renewal demands a fresh answer, which is exactly the work the network wants. The attacker pays: 2424 identities cost 3211 paid peers, 380752 tokens of stake and 3731 dollars. Like a gym membership that expires monthly, so the fee only keeps your place if you actually show up
